words.def: Fun is when you are having a really good time, like playing at the park.
ask: What do you do for fun?
words.sentence: We had so much fun at the beach!
words.adultDef: Fun is when you enjoy yourself and have a good time. Playing at the park, going to the beach and playing games with friends are lots of fun!

words.def: A cup is something we drink from, like water or milk.
ask: What do you like to drink from a cup?
words.sentence: Can I have a cup of water, please?
words.adultDef: A cup is a small container we drink from. We drink water, milk or juice from a cup. A trophy you win can also be called a cup!

words.def: A bus is a big, long car with lots of seats that carries lots of people.
ask: Have you been on a bus?
words.sentence: We wait for the bus at the bus stop.
words.adultDef: A bus is a big, long vehicle with lots of seats that carries many people. A school bus takes children to school, and we wait for a bus at the bus stop.

words.def: A bug is a tiny creepy-crawly, like an ant or a ladybird.
ask: What bugs have you seen in the garden?
words.sentence: A little bug crawled up the wall.
words.adultDef: A bug is a small insect or creepy-crawly, like an ant, a beetle or a ladybird. Lots of bugs live in the garden.

words.def: Mud is wet, sticky dirt. It makes your shoes messy!
words.sentence: My boots got stuck in the mud.
words.adultDef: Mud is wet, sticky dirt. When rain falls on the dirt it turns into mud – great for jumping in, but it makes your shoes very messy!

words.def: A hug is when you put your arms around someone you love.
ask: Who do you like to give a hug to?
words.sentence: Nan gave me a big hug.
words.adultDef: A hug is when you put your arms around someone and hold them close, to show you love them or to make them feel better.
